1. The “style_clip” parameter can select characters to speak with different expressions;

2. The “pose” parameter indicates the head position of the specified speaker. They are 3DMM parameter sequences extracted from the reference video. You can extract 3DMM parameters from your own video by following the PIRenderer. Please note that the video frame rate should be 25 FPS. In addition, videos for head pose reference should first be cropped to 256×256 using the scripts in FOMM video preprocessing (You should check this site for detailshttps://github.com/ali-vilab/dreamtalk).
